title: Book 5 — Terpsichore, Chapter 125
paragraphs: The opinion of Hecataeus, son of Hegesander, the historian, was that he should not take a colony to either of these places, but should build himself a wall of defense on the island of Leros and keep quiet, if he should be forced to leave Miletus; and afterwards, with this as his base, he would be able to return to Miletus.
